Definition: from the same as G43; a hook (as bent):--hook.
BiblicalUsage: Peter finds a coin in the mouth of the first fish he catches, enough to pay the temple tax for Jesus and himself. The word is the hook that caught the fish, a bent piece of metal with a job to do.
TheologicalSignificance: A single hook in a single miracle carries no teaching of its own; its wonder is the coin, that Jesus provided the tax from the sea.
